title: Blueprint — iPod patent / x-ray sizzle

secondary_motion: no springs or overshoot; only film grain boiling on every plate and on-twos stepping
color: saturated electric blue, x-ray blue/black and a thermal yellow/green LUT; strong but one treatment per section
typography: almost no type: labels inside patent drawings and a small blackletter wordmark at the end
shape_language: precise technical linework and x-rays, roughened by grain and mixed with handheld footage
character_humor: no characters; hands in footage and a witty 'show the product through its patents' device

signature: The iPod told through its patent drawings and x-rays: grainy blueprint-blue plates, stepped camera moves on twos and a 3-frame strobe montage, cut faster than the music.

music.summary: 103 BPM groove with a fairly clear pulse (0.62) but the edit ignores it (cuts on beat 14% vs 24% chance, median shot ~0.6 beats); the loudest hits land on the still end plates.

family_note: Mixed media: collage of footage, archive drawings and scans with heavy texture and color treatments, cut-driven. Not Elegant (grain, saturated blue, frantic cutting) nor Playful (no springs, no kinetic type). Differs from ref04 (2.5D camera flow) by being cut-driven with stepped moves; could justify a 'technical/archive collage' sub-style.

behaviors.mechanism: slow push/drift over still drawings and scans, updated every 2nd frame (12 fps feel on 24 fps)
behaviors.notes: Measured: frame diff alternates ~35/~1 over f262–f300 and f100–f140. duration_f = step length.

behaviors.mechanism: burst of 10 lifestyle footage shots, hard cut every 3 frames, right before the end plate
behaviors.notes: Cuts at f308,311,...,335 (cuts.txt). Not beat-locked: 3 f = 0.21 beat at 103 BPM.

behaviors.mechanism: frame split vertically at 50%: patent drawing on one half, footage on the other, halves swap; hard edges, no in-betweens
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet a_open (f16–f28): 6 f one way, 8 f swapped.

behaviors.mechanism: cut from a single patent drawing to a 3-up repeat of the same drawing
same x-ray imagery recolored with a thermal yellow/green LUT on a cut; color treatment marks the section
click wheel shrinks to a concentric target, cut to a giant bright ring of the same shape, then ~3% slow push
behaviors.notes: Ring radius 196→717 px in 1 frame (cut), then 717→740 px over 12 f. Curve shape not fitted (too small a move).

behaviors.mechanism: heavy noise/grain on the blue plates, boiling every frame even in holds
behaviors.notes: Visible in holds f336–f408 (pixel diff stays >0 in energy.png).

behaviors.mechanism: camera tracks down the patent's SONG 1…8 list, roughly one line per 2 frames (stepped)
behaviors.notes: Phase correlation aliased by repeated text; fit discarded. Read from sheet c_songs.

behaviors.mechanism: edit ignores the beat (cuts faster than the music); the loudest audio hits fall on the still patent plate and wordmark hold
behaviors.notes: audio.json: cuts on beat 0.14 vs chance 0.24; median shot 0.57 beats; onset peaks 14.7–15.6 s during holds.
